# Arun Suresh Kumar

> Technology executive based in Chicago, IL. Vice President of Information Technology at OptioRx. 20+ years leading enterprise engineering, IT, cloud transformation, data and analytics, cybersecurity and AI across healthcare and retail, including Fortune 500 organizations such as Sears/Kmart, DICK'S Sporting Goods, Cisco, Olay and FedEx.

Website: https://yeaske.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/yeaske
GitHub: https://github.com/yeaske

## Current role

- Vice President of Information Technology, OptioRx (May 2026 – present), Greater Chicago Area. Responsible for enterprise engineering, IT, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data and digital transformation strategy.
- Previously Director of Engineering at OptioRx (Jul 2023 – May 2026).

## Areas of expertise

- Enterprise IT strategy and digital transformation
- Cloud architecture and migration (AWS, GCP)
- Practical AI: strategy and adoption, model selection and evaluation, AI agents and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI governance and security, AI-assisted engineering
- Data, analytics and machine learning
- Cybersecurity and infrastructure modernization
- Enterprise architecture and scalable distributed systems (Python, Java/JEE, Angular)
- Engineering leadership and building cross-functional teams

## Career history

- OptioRx — VP of Information Technology; Director of Engineering (2023 – present)
- Transformco (Sears & Kmart) — Director, Software Engineering; Director, Engineering (Pune, India) (2019 – 2023). Led AWS migration of sears.com and kmart.com, GCP data-lake migration and Adobe Commerce integration.
- Sears Holdings Corporation — Director of Software Engineering; Senior Manager, Engineering; Enterprise Architect (2013 – 2019)
- DICK'S Sporting Goods — Solutions Architect, omnichannel mobility and web services (2015 – 2016)
- Infosys — Technology Lead, Technology Analyst, Software Engineer (2006 – 2013). Shop Your Way Rewards loyalty platform for Sears; Cisco Unified Communications Manager web services, encryption and disaster recovery.

## Education

- Bachelor's degree, Electronics and Communication Engineering — Marian Engineering College, Trivandrum (2002 – 2006)
